note: Leaf counts come from the OSDR ISA-Tab morphometric assay; rosette shape traits are PlantCV re-scores of the same plate scans. They are independent measurements of the same 16 sequenced plants.
time_axis: `day` counts from the first plate scan, 2021-05-02. No sowing date is published: the deposited ages and leaf counts admit no single sowing date (see sowing_date_check).
